test_execution.environment: Standalone apps/spa/vitest.config.ts using JSDOM and Vue Test Utils; no globalSetup; the selected tests import presentation components and fixture types, with no direct database/provider/network call found.

architecture_observations: CounterSalesPage.vue remains the owner of selected sale, forms, loading state, service calls, and workflow transitions. It passes presentation data and action handlers to the extracted children.

CounterSalesWorkbench.vue imports only design-system components and types; its props are read-only view data and its methods forward typed user intents through emits. It contains no service calls or independent workflow state.

CounterSalesWorkbench exposes typed field update events and workflow intents including catalog/barcode actions, quantity/discount changes, payment, close/cancel/reopen, quote conversion, printing, and clearing selection. The parent validates numeric form changes and owns service operations.

CounterSalesCard.vue accepts a read-only presentation model and emits the sale id from selection buttons; CounterSalesCardList owns loading/empty/list rendering and forwards selection. The card is exercised through the list test rather than a separate test file.
CounterSalesKpiSummary renders four parent-provided labels under a named section; its test checks the four-card count and values.
Native details/summary disclosures are used for sale details and contacts. CSS includes a 1100px workbench collapse and card header reflow; no browser viewport or visual comparison was run.

The focused tests cover five cases: list selection/loading/empty, KPI labels, workbench sale rendering, add-catalog/payment/back intents, and empty histories. They do not cover the remaining workbench events or parent service mutations.

candidate_actions.hold_reason: CounterSalesPage.vue and CounterSalesPage.test.ts are not counted in this round and retain the service/workflow boundary. Candidate inclusion also requires independent critique, browser interaction/accessibility/viewport review, and completed provenance/sensitivity review.

limitations: This round adds only four extracted component source paths and three corresponding component tests to the original 386-path content-review denominator; the tracked parent page, page test, and service tests remain pending.
JSDOM component tests establish the exercised props/render/emits only. Payment, sale lifecycle, persistence, inventory, patient context, and route behavior were not integration-tested in this round.
No browser-based download, responsive viewport, keyboard/focus, screen-reader, or visual QA was performed; CSS presence alone does not prove visual behavior.
All seven paths remain held from overlay pending parent workflow review, independent critique, candidate-bound inventory, and applicable browser QA.
